summary: PAID Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to an existing forbearance agreement with Embolx Inc., extending the maturity of a senior secured convertible note from September 30, 2025 (previously extended) to October 31, 2026. The note, originally $1.875M with OID and default penalties, has grown to approximately $5.967M with a 25% interest rate. This is a routine creditor forbearance extension, not a special situation event such as restructuring or liquidation. The filing contains no new deal terms, board actions, or strategic reviews, and the registrant is acting solely as a lender. No special-situation category applies.
